subject.title: fix(channels): progress drafts only for long tasks, with the model's own preamble as the status headline

question: Should progress mode permanently use fresh model preambles as an always-on Discord and Telegram headline and expose the three supporting lifecycle fields through the public reply-options API?
rationale: The time-gate repair fixes defined behavior, but the headline default and public plugin API additions establish new cross-channel product and compatibility contracts that code review cannot authorize from implementation quality alone.

options.title: Approve the shared headline contract
options.body: Keep the always-on preamble headline and additive lifecycle API, but merge only after the retraction defect is fixed and live channel proof is attached.

options.title: Keep headlines opt-in
options.body: Route preambles only through the existing commentary configuration and retain the time-gate and narration-efficiency fixes without changing the default headline contract.

options.title: Split the changes
options.body: Land the narrow time-gate and lifecycle repair first, then review the headline and plugin API expansion as a separately sponsored change.

recommendation.title: Approve the shared headline contract
recommendation.body: Keep the always-on preamble headline and additive lifecycle API, but merge only after the retraction defect is fixed and live channel proof is attached.

likelyOwner.reason: The canonical issue, self-assignment, and complete implementation history make this person the clearest available owner of the intended progress-draft contract.
